title: Parity Concierge: Compatibility Playbook for Fallback Model Variants
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a pragmatic, automated playbook (the 'Parity Concierge') to maintain and surface compatibility information across fallback model variants. This ticket covers: an authorable compatibility matrix format, tooling to auto-detect tokenizer/context/KV-cache mismatches, integration with the Console rollout UI, and an automated notification/PR flow for variant owners when parity drifts are detected. The goal is to reduce runtime fallback incidents and make safe fallback policies easier to maintain without manual audits.
acceptance_criteria: A human- and machine-readable compatibility manifest schema is defined and documented (Confluence + repo README)
A CI job that runs cross-variant tokenization parity checks (sample corpus) and reports diffs to a generated GitHub PR exists
Runtime uses the manifest to decide whether to allow automatic fallback or require model pinning; mismatches are logged and surfaced in Console
Console shows per-variant parity status and a one-click remediation link to open the suggested PR or rollback policy
Telemetry signals for parity drift, fallback-induced error spike, and cache-compatibility failures are instrumented and wired to alerts

notes: Trade-offs considered: strict tokenization parity reduces surprise fallbacks but increases operational overhead; the chosen approach is to allow configurable normalization (unicode normalization, punctuation stripping, sentencepiece remapping) so teams can opt into conservative or permissive fallback policies. We will iterate based on telemetry and customer incidents.
